name: agentic-harness
description: Idea/BRD/SRS-to-code agentic workflow: a question-driven planning phase (BRD, SRS, design context, features, ADRs, epics) hands off to a manager agent that owns business goals and a senior-engineer architect that segments the codebase, creates and removes scoped subagents (and temporary swarms) per segment, and staffs a standing test-writer. Durable test-gated TASKS.md, optional mirroring to external trackers (ClickUp, etc).
